core_insights.title: One weakness, many stages
core_insights.headline: Use of Hard-coded Credentials (CWE-798) underlies 5 of 10 CVEs and reaches 5 of 8 tactic subtrees. Ranked one by one they read as separate findings; the tree groups them under one recurring weakness.

facts.label: Tactic subtrees
facts.value: 5 of 8 (Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion, Credential Access)

facts.label: Same for all of them
facts.value: attack complexity LOW, privileges required NONE, user interaction NONE

core_insights.note: CVE-2020-12039 scores 2.4 and would rank low by severity alone, yet it feeds the same weakness-centred progression as the others.

core_insights.title: Path count is not CVE count
core_insights.headline: Defense Evasion has 14 paths from 7 CVEs, while Initial Access has 1 path from 5 CVEs. CVE count is only a rough guide to how many paths a tactic opens.

facts.label: Dominant CVE there
facts.value: CVE-2020-12041 alone gives 9 of 14 paths, through 5 techniques and 7 CAPEC patterns

facts.label: Collapse
facts.value: all 5 CVEs lead to one step: Valid Accounts: Default Accounts (T1078.001)

core_insights.title: Redundancy shows where one control helps twice
core_insights.headline: 44 CAPEC references collapse to 20 distinct patterns (54.5% repeat one already used in another tactic). The same mechanisms recur across stages, so one control can cut paths in several of them.

core_insights.note: A control aimed at Valid Accounts: Default Accounts (T1078.001) would reach paths under Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion.

additional_insights.title: Where a fix removes the most paths
additional_insights.headline: Fixing CVE-2020-12041 alone removes 25 of 51 paths (49.0%), the most of any single CVE. Its base score ranks only #7 of 9, so severity alone would not point to it.
additional_insights.note: A path is removed only when every CVE supporting it is fixed. Sets are the best of all combinations of that size (greedy for very large devices).

additional_insights.title: How easily the paths can be reached
additional_insights.headline: 51 of 51 paths (100.0%) can be driven remotely: at least one supporting CVE is reachable over the network with no privileges and no user interaction.

facts.label: Physical access is the only route

additional_insights.note: Taken from each CVE's CVSS metrics; a path counts at the easiest of its CVEs.

additional_insights.title: Which weakness feeds the most paths
additional_insights.headline: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource (CWE-732) supports 25 of 51 paths (49.0%) from 1 CVE.
